description: This file contains hardware initialization code for the NXP i.MX microcontroller, including Resource Domain Controller setup, cache initialization, clock setup, and system initialization for the M4 core.

methods.name: SOC_RdcInit
methods.description: Initializes the Resource Domain Controller, setting domain IDs and access permissions for various peripherals based on device tree status.

methods.name: SOC_CacheInit
methods.description: Initializes system and code bus caches, invalidating and enabling caches and write buffers.

methods.name: SOC_ClockInit
methods.description: Configures clock sources and enables clocks for UART, EPIT, I2C, and PWM peripherals based on configuration macros and device tree status.

methods.name: mcimx6x_m4_init
methods.description: Performs overall hardware initialization: RDC setup, disables watchdog powerdown, cache, and clock initialization.
